notes: The initial 105-test four-backend run used source_files and initial_validated_release. After the 8Mi-checkpoint-plus-11-unit resume-envelope boundary correction, all strict checks, backend tests, parity, independent references, checkpoint checks and stream measurements were rerun against the final Linux native and JavaScript builds. Top-level binary/reference/stream hashes identify this final build; earlier command steps are historical.
final_source_synchronization lists every source difference from the initial copied snapshot; final_source_files records the final checkout.

The final README checkpoint-to-fourth-frame example was executed on all four backends. The independently extracted pinned MBMOT/MoonDetEval consumer workspace was checked and tested offline on all four backends after documentation synchronization.

Final web/app.mjs and web/ui.test.cjs sources, including the asynchronous checkpoint-file revision guard and delayed calibration-fetch edit guard, were synchronized after the final Linux validation commands. The static site had been built before this last source synchronization. No desktop/mobile/local-file browser UI test is executed in this Linux environment; the final Windows browser results and hosted CI are separate evidence. This source synchronization does not alter the compiled MoonBit native or bridge artifacts.

No Windows compiled artifact or .mooncakes directory was copied. The two consumer registry ZIPs were copied as checksum-verified source archives into the private Linux registry cache, then extracted and compiled by the Linux toolchain.
